summary: PolyPid filed a Form 6-K containing its Q2 2026 earnings press release and corporate update. The release highlights FDA acceptance of its D-PLEX NDA with Priority Review (PDUFA date Nov 28, 2026) and an exclusive U.S./Canada commercialization partnership with Azurity, including $30M upfront/near-term milestones and over $290M in additional milestones plus tiered royalties. However, the 6-K is a routine earnings and operational update; no special-situation event such as an acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring is disclosed. It is a standard foreign private issuer report, so no special-situation classification applies.
